Same Day Smile Sedation Dentistry Review Us Contact to Smilecology! At Smilecology, our mission is to enhance lives through dedicated, patient-centered dental care. We believe everyone deserves a future of wellness and well-being. Patients should expect personalized and gentle care when they visit Smilecology. Dr. Thihan Phan is committed to serving her patients in Avondale, Litchfield Park, Goodyear, and the surrounding areas with honest services, long-term dental health, and beautiful smiles. We emphasize our 3 C’s: Capability, Comfort, and Convenience. Our dentist and staff are skilled and experienced, so you can relax knowing that you are in very capable hands. You will also find your visits convenient and hassle-free. Between advanced dental technology and caring team members, you will have an enjoyable experience here. Whether you need general, restorative, or cosmetic dental services, we would love to help. Smilecology is now accepting new patients. We would love to connect! Meet the Team NEW PATIENT SPECIAL OFFER Testimonials Play Video Dentist Avondale AZ Smilecology is a wellness-focused dental office dedicated to supporting busy families in the Avondale area with convenient, comprehensive care. Read Our Testimonials Dr. Thihan C. Phan and the staff at Smilecology offer comprehensive dental treatment, with a complete range of cosmetic dentistry, restorative dentistry, and general dentistry. Each team member possesses an unwavering dedication to impeccable service and exemplary dental care. Your comfort is our Avondale AZ dentist' s top priority, and we have created a friendly, welcoming environment for you to enjoy. What our patients say… Play Video “The care of Dr. Phan and her entire staff for the past 8 years has been first class” - Anthony Play Video “It’s almost fun going to the dentist now” - Jane Play Video “It makes you feel more comfortable knowing that it’s going to be done properly.” - Joanne Smilecology In our practice, we build lasting relationships with patients and exceed their expectations for great dental care. Count on Dr. Thihan C. Phan to listen to your goals and concerns, address your issues, and answer all of your questions. You will feel secure in our abilities and confident in our care. Our team will not only treat you well, but we will also carefully monitor your teeth and gums, noting changes from visit to visit. Our team will stay ahead of the latest advances in dental technology, including the latest in laser dentistry for periodontal gum therapy and contemporary techniques for implant dentistry. We have selected proven treatment methods to promote your smile’s health, strength, and appearance. Part of our commitment to patients involves taking the time to explain your current dental health and make sure that you understand the pros and cons of each possible treatment. Once we equip patients with the knowledge to make educated decisions, we leave those choices up to you. Dr. Thihan C. Phan wants you to move forward with treatment only when you feel prepared and comfortable. Recommended services may include: cosmetic dentistry, general dentistry and restorative dentistry. Our Avondale practice provides patients with positive dental experiences that will protect and maintain their smiles. Please contact our office today. We look forward to hearing from you. Request An Appointment What We Offer Convenient Appointments Convenient dental appointments make it easy to prioritize your oral health with flexible scheduling options that fit seamlessly into your busy life. Personalized Care Personalized dental care tailors treatments to each patient's unique needs and goals, ensuring a more comfortable and effective path to optimal oral health. Full Price Transparency We present all costs upfront and you and your dentist (not insurance companies) can decide what's best for you. Costs are HSA and FSA eligible. Would you believe seeing your dentist could actually feel this good and be easy? At Smilecology, our philosophy centers on transforming dental care into a nurturing self-care experience, not just a reaction to dental issues. We know you’re busy caring for everyone else—now, let us take care of you. Request An Appointment Dental Implants Dental implants are a permanent solution to replace missing or extracted teeth. You don’t need to sacrifice your confidence or oral health when you lose teeth–instead, you can preserve your jawbone and your beautiful smile with dental implants. They are screws placed into the jawbone that serve as anchors for dentures, crowns, or bridges. CLICK HERE to read more about Dental Implants. Same Day Smile You can achieve a brand new smile in one day with CEREC technology at Smilecology. In one brief appointment, we can design durable dental crowns that are customized to the shade and shape of your teeth. The procedure is ideal for patients who are pressed for time and looking for an immediate solution that will result in a beautiful smile. CLICK HERE to read more about Same Day Smile. Cosmetic Dentistry Are there things about your smile that you wish you could change? At our practice, we can help you achieve the smile of your dreams with cosmetic dentistry. We offer teeth whitening, veneers, bonding and more! CLICK HERE to read more about Cosmetic Dentistry. Invisalign If you suffer from malocclusion or crooked teeth, you may appreciate the convenience of Invisalign. Many of our Arizona patients opt for these smooth, clear “invisible braces” so they can maintain their brace-free appearance while they achieve flawless smiles. CLICK HERE to read more about Invisalign. No Interest Financing – 0% Down Helping you get your smile back LETS CONNECT A dental team you can trust You deserve a dental team you can trust and a radiant smile you can proudly display. From teeth whitening to dental implants to Invisalign clear braces, we offer patients comprehensive dental care. This means, we attend to the details, find the underlying causes of problems, and then deliver lasting solutions. OUR SPACE Our address is 3400 N Dysart Rd Ste G 125; Avondale, AZ 85392 - Cayla W.
